{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Check for duplicate patient_ids
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of rows:", len(df))

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
multi_sample = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
duplicates = multi_sample[multi_sample > 1]
print("Patients with multiple sample_seq:", len(duplicates))
print("Their patient_ids:", duplicates.index.tolist())"}
